name: Brachiomon
main_effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] If your opponent has 4 or less memory, 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 8000 DP or more can't attack until the end of their turn. If they have 4 or more, delete 1 of their Digimon with 6000 DP or less.
source_effect: [On Deletion] Return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 7000 DP or less to the hand.
